outputs: translated text from source language speech

changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant output descriptions, consolidated to one clear description. Kept only main model names (CTC-NAST, CTC-Aug ST, AR models) removing 'Base AR' and 'Base NAR' variants. Added missing Japanese language. Normalized terminology.

Simplified SacreBLEU to BLEU as it's an implementation of BLEU metric. Removed duplicate WER entry. The paper uses BLEU (including SacreBLEU implementation) for translation quality and WER for error analysis.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper. The paper focuses on traditional automatic metrics and architectural improvements.
No human evaluation conducted in this paper. Evaluation is entirely based on automatic metrics (BLEU, WER).

overall_notes: This paper presents CTC-based non-autoregressive speech translation model. The extraction quality was good overall. The paper focuses on architectural innovations for speech translation with evaluation using automatic metrics only. Key contributions include prediction-aware encoding, cross-layer attention, and curriculum learning mixing to address CTC limitations for translation tasks.
